about: Lori A. Goldstein is an attorney providing legal services covering Employment & Labor: Employer and Employment & Labor: Employee.

Lori Goldstein, who practices law in Northfield, Illinois, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2016 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of Illinois College of Law. She graduated in 1984. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1984.
